beats.summary: Andy sets rules for Halloween costumes and vetoes Kevin's gorilla costume due to spoilers.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I've decided to pre-screen all the Halloween costumes this year. I have three simple rules – don't be offensive, don't be cliche, and don't take the first two rules too seriously.

Kevin: The gorilla from Rise of the Planet of the Apes? Huh? The one who sacrifices his life.
Andy: Whoa! Aw, spoiler alert.
Kevin: It's been out for ages, man.
Andy: Costume vetoed.

beats.summary: Kelly and Meredith argue about Kate Middleton and the royal wedding.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: This is ridiculous! Why can't there just be two Kate Middleton's?
Meredith: Because I was there. Your the people's princess! Diana was nothing!

beats.summary: Erin reflects on the benefits of dating a coworker, emphasizing continued daily interaction after dating ends.

evidence.snippet: Erin: When they talk about all the nice things about dating a coworker, they don't mention one of the best parts. After you're done dating, you still get to work together, every single day.

beats.summary: Jim reluctantly agrees to wear a jersey to complete a group costume with Darryl and Kevin.

evidence.snippet:
Kevin: Jim, put it on.
Darryl: Put it on, man.
Jim: I don't know if I can.
Kevin: Come on, the Three Amigos.
Darryl: Three Kings.
Jim: Alright.
Jim: I know, I know, I know. But Darryl and Kevin needed a third. They bought me this jersey. I said no. Kevin started crying. So, I am Chris Bosh.

beats.summary: Pam shares a ghost story about the Man In Black at the Banshee Pub.

evidence.snippet: Pam: …and he said, That's what everyone sees, that's the Man In Black.

beats.summary: Robert California questions Kelly and Toby about their feelings and fears during the Halloween party.

evidence.snippet:
Robert: You feeling fulfilled in your life?
Kelly: I guess.
Robert: You guess? So, there is something you want that you do not have.
Kelly: I try not to think about it.
